Title: Path to Myrkgard
Description: @0717_0101_myrkgardarena_objective_desc
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_nodConsider" />Indeed. We believe the Tempest is down beneath the ruins of Myrkgard,<g id="female_shakeheadNo" /> but getting in there won't be easy.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_explain" />Make sure to rally some other Wardens to your side, and then collect the Orbs from the Monoliths.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: @0717_0101_myrkgardarena_complete_available_response

Title: Pushing Back
Description: Eliminate the Corrupted in Weeping-and-Gnashing and Corpus Angoris, and recover any supplies left behind. Then report back to Warden Reese in Shattered Mountain.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: It feels like the Corrupted keep getting stronger - I'm not sure how much longer we can defend this spot.
InProgressResponse: Weaken the Corrupted's position in the forts so we can get supplies through to Clarion.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: That was quite impressive, but somehow I'm not surprised. Now we can finally re-establish supply lines with Clarion.

Title: Our Own Worst Enemy
Description: Search for Soulwarden Heartgems across the five forts in Shattered Mountain, and search for any Corrupted writings. Then report back to Ranger Madaki in Shattered Mountain.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Bah, same as they do in the Cleave and everywhere else - they turn our own against us.
InProgressResponse: Get me as many Heartgems as you can find and any Corrupted Writings.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Well I'll be damned, you got more Heartgems than I expected. Sad is what that is.

Title: The Illurmin Rift
Description: Explore the deadly Illurmin Rift and deliver your discoveries to Warden Linch in Shattered Mountain.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Yes, but I wouldn't take the road.
InProgressResponse: The things coming out of the Rift are scary enough to make you mess your smallclothes if you're not prepared.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: I'll be a weathered knob on an Angry Spriggan's arse! Someone finally made it through!

Title: Guardians' Secrets
Description: Defeat Guardian Tzi-Wang, recover Baetylus Luckstones, and defeat Rockruins Guardians in Limbus Cavatus. Then report back to Warden Reese in Shattered Mountain.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Well, I'm no bookish researcher like William Heron, but you have to admit - those Ancients knew some things.
InProgressResponse: Limbus Cavatus is certainly a hike, I know... but it's worth a shot.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Ah, thank goodness... You made it back! That bony wretch didn't give you too much trouble, I hope?

Title: Alligator Steaks
Description: Hunt Shattered Alligators for Gator Steaks and seek out bundles of Mirespice Blend held by the Desolate Scroungers. Then report back to Warden Douglas in Shattered Mountain.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_explain" />I've been trying to think of a way to cheer people up, <g id="male_giveup" />but it's just not a cheery place.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_headnodding" />Shattered Gator Meat and Mirespice Blend, and then we'll be cooking… <g id="male_patience" />or is it better to eat it raw?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_notsure" />I may have had… second thoughts… <g id="male_lookDown" />while you were away.

Title: Malevolent Offerings
Description: End the rituals in Hewn-from-Hell and Mantled-in-Nettles by eliminating the Corrupted Vicars, their guards, and their Corruption Barbs, then reclaim their Corrupted ritual implements. Then report back to Warden Linch in Shattered Mountain.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Aye, and now we fight for our very souls, and those of every living creature on the face of the Earth.
InProgressResponse: Whatever it takes, break up those rituals, destroy the Vicars, and take the implements of their evil.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Finally, an end to those infernal rituals! I can feel the difference already. We all can.

Title: Clarion Offensive
Description: Defeat Dau-Shin and recover Armor Scraps from the Rockrift Carvers in Limbus Cavatus. Then report back to Warden Fayed in Shattered Mountain.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I'm glad you agree. Before we can do so, however, we have to make ourselves less vulnerable.
InProgressResponse: If we can get some of the armor from Limbus Cavatus, it will help us withstand the Corrupted.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Aha, a successful mission, I presume? Yes, Dau-Shin defeated and these armor scraps will do nicely.

Title: Knowledge is Power
Description: Get a fresh blight sample from a Blight Nodule in Wanhope Wold. Then report back to Ranger Herath in Shattered Mountain.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: We know some of the Corrupted in Edengrove have proven susceptible to the Blight.
InProgressResponse: If you can get me fresh Blight samples, I can do the rest.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Aha, the procurer of the ingredients for my experiment!

Title: Blight Resistance
Description: Collect a Blight Sample from the Baleful Lair and defeat Fay, the Last Protector. Bring a piece of his remains to Ranger Herath in Shattered Mountain.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Ah, now that you mention it, I did notice some Angry Earth in the region that seem impervious.
InProgressResponse: Fay and his band of Dryads are a force unto themselves.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Wait, you faced down Fay and survived to return? I must confess, I had my doubts.

Title: Madaki's Stratagem
Description: Search the forges of Infernal Host for any weapon molds or crucibles they might be using to forge weapons of great power. Then report back to Ranger Madaki in Shattered Mountain.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Possibly. My study has indicated they need unique molds to properly complete each weapon.
InProgressResponse: If it is possible to use these Ancient forging techniques, that is an advantage we need to deny the Corrupted…
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You've returned. I'm impressed and cautiously optimistic. You found the crucibles?

Title: Baetylus Headpiece (Expedition)
Description: Defeat the Cilla in the Lazarus Instrumentality Expedition and Collect the Naga Headdress. Then report back to Warden Reese in Shattered Mountain.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Definitely a dodgy place, in Reekwater. If you can find others as mad as you, it might be worth it.
InProgressResponse: Are you really going to venture into the Lazarus Instrumentality…?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Welcome back to the front, {playerName}. Wait, the Lazarus Instrumentality? You can't mean…

Title: Ultimate Blight Defense (Expedition)
Description: Defeat the Alluvium Marl and Collect Alluvium Spores for Ranger Herath in Shattered Mountain.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Yes, a sacred place for the Angry Earth, perhaps the most sacred.
InProgressResponse: The Alluvium Marl in the Garden of Genesis, I have no idea what to expect…
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Well, this is truly beyond the pale - you're the first I've seen venture into the Garden and return.

Title: The Tempest's Soul (Expedition)
Description: Enter Tempest's Heart and Defeat Isabella de Leon.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_nodYes" />Precisely. <g id="male_patience" />You have no doubt heard of the Tempest and have come seeking her ruin. But what do you know of Captain Isabella? <g id="male_spreadhands" />What does anyone know?
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_thinking" />I have found accounts scattered across this island by those who had contact with Isabella. <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />The story they tell is grim.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: So it is true…<g id="female_headshakeSmall" /> Isabella de Leon is no more. <g id="male_lookDown" />This is only the beginning.

Title: Isabella De Leon (Expedition)
Description: Find out about Isabella's past in Spain with her brothers. Then defeat Isabella de Leon again with this new knowledge in mind.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_explain" />We all have family. She also had brothers. <g id="female_thinking" />Could they have stopped Isabella's descent into madness?
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_thinking" />I am curious to know whether our ill-fated Captain had help or hindrance from her brothers.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_nodYes" />Ah, so Philip and Cosimo squandered their fortune and family name away. <g id="female_thinking" />It's no wonder Isabella became so isolated and desperate.

Title: Isabella's Corruption (Expedition)
Description: Find out about how Isabella was offered the mantle of Corruption. Then defeat Isabella de Leon with this new knowledge in mind.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_listenforward" priority="high" />But how can we know for sure?
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_explain" />I left my convent to discover all I could about Isabella. The rumors of her fate frightened me. <g id="female_thinking" />But they also piqued my interest.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />It was a swift downfall then. Isabella ate the forbidden fruit with no remorse. <g id="male_crossarmsUpset" />This is... disheartening.

Title: Rise of Captain Isabella (Expedition)
Description: Find out about Isabella's descent into cruelty with her crew by investigating the graves where they were buried alive. Then defeat Isabella de Leon with this new knowledge in mind.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />Still, I must believe that some part of the noble woman remained.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_convince01" />Please discover more about Isabella's trek across the island.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_worry" />She buried them alive? Oh God, she condemned them to the earth,<g id="female_shakeheadNo" /> a terrible fate on Aeternum.

Title: Death of the Heretic (Expedition)
Description: Find out about the Heretic's true power and talk to the Heretic. Then defeat Isabella de Leon with this new knowledge in mind.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_shocked" />She was misled! That much I know for sure. Is the Heretic the source of Corruption? <g id="female_nodConsider" />That would explain it.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_rememberBig" />Aunt Isabella was as beautiful as an angel. <g id="female_bowShallow" />She was devout and prayed at Church often.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_drawbackAfraid" />You bring me a name I have never heard before: Nedenyek. <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />It chills my very soul.

Title: The Possession of Russo (Expedition)
Description: Find out the truth about Isabella and Father Russo, and what is to come, and talk to Father Russo. Then defeat Isabella de Leon with this new knowledge in mind.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_crossarmsDoubt" />I do not know. Perhaps it is as you said <g id="male_spreadhands" />- Isabella had no one.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_lookforwardWonder" />In another life, perhaps Father Russo and Isabella could have been together. <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />We will never know.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_lookConcern" />So she turned away from Father Russo, who loved her with all of his heart.

Title: Isabella's Madness (Expedition)
Description: Recover a shard of Isabella's madness in the ashes of her defeat for Mara Rosa to study.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_nodYes" />That seems just.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_clasphandsRequest" />Have you collected another Shard of Madness? <g id="male_think" />Perhaps these memories will help point a way toward her salvation someday. We must always have hope.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_explain" />This Shard of Madness is full of pain. I shall store it with the others.
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: Aunt Isabella rests peaceful for now, <g id="female_clasphandsGratitude" />but I fear in time the corruption will rise again.<g id="female_saluteFistchest" /> On that day, I pray you come to our aid yet again.
